question: Who among the following was the first woman commando trainer in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Seema Rao.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seema Rao** is **India's first woman commando trainer,** having trained Special Forces of India for over two decades without compensation.
 
• She is popularly known as** “Wonder Woman of India”.**** **
 
• Rao has co-authored two books **"Encyclopedia of Close Combat Ops" and "A Comprehensive Analysis of World Terrorism".**
 
• She has also written a book** "Handbook of World Terrorism" along with her husband.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rani Rampal:**

 
 
• She is an Indian field hockey player from Haryana.
 
• She was the **youngest player** in the national hockey team that participated in the 2010 World Cup.
 
• She was just 15 years old during the** 2010 World Cup**.
 
• She is the** captain of the Indian Women's Hockey team** currently and is considered one of the best female hockey players in the world.
 
 
 
• **Avani Chaturvedi :**
 
 
• She made history by becoming the** first female fighter pilot**.
 
• She was commissioned into the fighter stream in June 2016 as one of the first batch of three women officers to be trained as fighter pilots.
